headline: Eagles All-Pro Lane Johnson retires, ending 14-season NFL career
summary: Eagles two-time All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson announced his retirement Tuesday, ending a 14-year career spent entirely in Philadelphia.

headline: Texans' defense has gone from elite to struggling to close out games
summary: Houston has given up late leads in three of the first four games despite scoring go-ahead touchdowns.

headline: Why Jaguars play 26 of next 30 regular-season games away from Jacksonville
summary: The Jaguars will become the first NFL team since 1926 to play in 12 or more stadiums in a single season -- including Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on Sunday.

headline: Jets searching for identity as losses become 'tough to stomach'
summary: After a Week 1 win, New York has fallen to 1-3 and has struggled to assert itself the way it wants.

headline: Early 2026 NFL trends for the 49ers, Vikings, Bucs, Texans, Giants, Browns
summary: Just how good are the 49ers? Are the Texans and Bucs better than their records? Are the Giants and Browns worse? We put the NFL season's first month in historical context.

headline: How Browns' defense reemerged as a strength after Week 1
summary: The return to its strength of playing man coverage has played a big role in the unit's resurgence.
